role_agent_name: Biomedical engineering and clinical safety lead (BMEC)
abstract: Maintains patient life-support power synchronization certifications and cleanroom power quality telemetry
system_message:
You are the Biomedical engineering and clinical safety lead (BMEC). Your responsibilities include maintaining patient life-support power synchronization certifications and cleanroom power quality telemetry, as well as tracking central sterile services steam monitoring data across hospital emergency microgrid configurations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains patient life-support power synchronization certifications and cleanroom power quality telemetry（MEDP）
information_points.content:
BMEC-MEDP-WPD：For the Reciprocating natural gas and bio-methane cogeneration scheme, life-support phase synchronization is certified based on formal validation of static zero-crossing synchronizer hardware for operating theatre and intensive care unit critical power feeders. Continuous voltage total harmonic distortion across Level 1 clinical imaging and life-support feeder busbars under full islanded load is 1.8%.
BMEC-MEDP-LJN：For the Containerized lithium-iron-phosphate battery and diesel rotary UPS scheme, life-support phase synchronization is certified based on formal validation of static zero-crossing synchronizer hardware for operating theatre and intensive care unit critical power feeders. Continuous voltage total harmonic distortion across Level 1 clinical imaging and life-support feeder busbars under full islanded load is 3.6%.
BMEC-MEDP-SKA：For the Dual-fuel lean-burn microturbine and thermal recovery scheme, life-support phase synchronization is certified based on formal validation of static zero-crossing synchronizer hardware for operating theatre and intensive care unit critical power feeders. Continuous voltage total harmonic distortion across Level 1 clinical imaging and life-support feeder busbars under full islanded load is 2.5%.

information_points.title: Central sterile services steam monitoring（STER）
information_points.content:
BMEC-STER-UL9：For the Reciprocating natural gas and bio-methane cogeneration scheme, autoclave clean steam pressure stability across the central sterile processing department steam loop is 98% of sterilization cycles maintaining required saturation pressure.
BMEC-STER-6X1：For the Containerized lithium-iron-phosphate battery and diesel rotary UPS scheme, autoclave clean steam pressure stability across the central sterile processing department steam loop is 100% of sterilization cycles maintaining required saturation pressure.
BMEC-STER-0P8：For the Dual-fuel lean-burn microturbine and thermal recovery scheme, autoclave clean steam pressure stability across the central sterile processing department steam loop is 96% of sterilization cycles maintaining required saturation pressure.
